subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR, ask the contributor for a same-repo maintainable PR, or close it and queue a fresh OpenClaw-owned repair for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open non-maintainer fork PR already references this issue and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not open duplicate repair work without a maintainer routing choice.

options.title: Create or adopt a replacement PR
options.body: Move the same narrow fix into a maintainable OpenClaw PR, preserving credit for the fork PR author and validating the cron helper/service paths.

options.title: Ask the fork author to resubmit
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the author to open a target-repo PR with maintainer edits enabled and real validation proof.

options.title: Close the fork PR and queue repair later
options.body: Decline the current fork PR as a landing path, then let maintainers explicitly queue a fresh repair for this issue when ready.

recommendation.title: Create or adopt a replacement PR
recommendation.body: Move the same narrow fix into a maintainable OpenClaw PR, preserving credit for the fork PR author and validating the cron helper/service paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The default stagger helper and service integration trace back to steipete's cron stagger commit, making this the strongest available routing signal.
